The full suite passes (BUILD SUCCESS). The change is complete.

## Summary

The spec required de-duplicating a new owner's `customerCode` when it collides with an existing owner's code, appending `-<n>` with the smallest `n ≥ 2` that makes it unique.

**`OwnerCustomerCode.java`** — added a `deduplicate(String base, Set<String> existing)` helper (the single source of truth for the code shape), which returns `base` when free, otherwise probes `base-2`, `base-3`, … and returns the first unused candidate.

**`AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java`** — the step now injects `OwnerRepository`, collects the existing owners' customer codes, and assigns the de-duplicated result. Its Javadoc was updated to drop the old "no repository lookup needed" claim and describe the collision rule. This runs before `assignMembershipNumber`, which derives from `customerCode`, so the membership number naturally inherits the unique value.

The new `AcceptanceTest.coreCustomerCodesStayUnique` and the full test suite are green (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
